package.name: apollo_ros2_bridge
package.description: Bridges Apollo channels and standard ROS 2 messages in both directions: point clouds, images, localization (nav_msgs/Odometry + tf), transforms (tf2_msgs), IMU, GNSS (NavSatFix), planning trajectories (nav_msgs/Path) and perception obstacles (visualization_msgs/MarkerArray), so RViz, rosbag2 and ROS 2 drivers work with Apollo.
